Fresh off its premiere at the Venice Film Festival, the gritty French courtroom thriller 'The Good Lawyer' (Un Bon Avocat) is officially coming to Netflix on November 9, 2026.

The film reunites 'Class Act' director Tristan Séguéla with leading man Laurent Lafitte, who plays a brilliant but addicted criminal defense lawyer. After collapsing in court and doing a stint in rehab, he has just one week to prepare for the trial of a lifetime involving a powerful industrial group and an international terrorist network.

An A-list French cast rounds out the production, including Anthony Bajon, Mélanie Laurent, and Carole Bouquet. Get all the details on the upcoming release:

New first look at STEPS.

Featuring Ali Wong, Amanda Seyfried, Stephanie Hsu, Nikki Glaser, Bette Midler, Young Mazino, Daniel Radcliffe, Peter Dinklage and Damian Priest.

Coming to Netflix on November 20th.

'A Couple of Lies' is the next Swedish psychological thriller to watch on Netflix. Starring Frida Gustavsson and Fares Fares, the 4-part series follows a house swap between two couples that quickly turns into a game of surveillance and mistrust.

The series is based on Stefan Ahnhem’s novel and is currently set to arrive on Netflix on October 30, 2026. Here is everything we know about the cast and plot.
MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY is now streaming!

Imagine being the most famous actor in Japan, having a triumphant performance in London, and returning home only to realize nobody knows who you are. That's the premise of Netflix's upcoming Japanese comedy series, 'Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?'.

Starring Yakusho Koji alongside Alice in Borderland's Kaku Kento and Like a Dragon's Kawai Yuumi, the series explores a superstar's life after he hits rock bottom and must start entirely from scratch. 

'Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?' arrives on October 22, 2026. Here is everything we know so far about the cast, crew, and plot.

Netflix has officially announced the release date for its upcoming Japanese romantic drama, 'One Year to Live, Buy a Man.' Starring Ko Shibasaki and Eiji Akaso, the film is scheduled to arrive globally on November 5, 2026.

Based on the novel by Toriko Yoshikawa, the story follows a woman who, after receiving a terminal diagnosis, decides to stop saving money and "buys" the companionship of a nightclub host. It promises to be a deeply emotional look at an unpredictable love forming under unconventional circumstances.

Netflix's 3-part crime docuseries 'Hunting Gary Glitter' will be released globally on October 14, 2026.

"A string of dogged journalists chases fugitive pop star Gary Glitter across the globe from Cuba to Cambodia to Vietnam, determined to expose the child sexual abuse he concealed behind decades of chart-topping fame. This documentary follows their pursuit alongside the survivors who speak out, charting Glitter's 1997 conviction, through to his years on the run, and eventual incarceration."

Time is running out to catch several major titles on Netflix UK. Removals for October 2026 include the hit comedy Tropic Thunder, the sci-fi epic The Wandering Earth, and all seasons of Victoria.

While the list isn't as expansive as the September wave of departures, there are still plenty of movies and shows across every genre leaving the library. Stay up to date with the complete list below.
New poster for THE DIPLOMAT season 4 - coming to Netflix one month today!

Here is your first look at Animals coming to Netflix on October 9, 2026.

Animals stars Ben Affleck, Kerry Washington, Steven Yeun, Gillian Anderson, Ray Fisher, and Matt Gerald.

"When their son is kidnapped, a Los Angeles mayoral candidate and his wife find themselves drawn into a web of deception. As they scramble to raise the ransom payment, they’re forced to make choices and reveal secrets – that could tear their world apart."

Netflix UK is looking stacked for October 2026. From the highly anticipated adaptation of East of Eden starring Florence Pugh to the return of fan-favorites like Lupin and The Diplomat, there is plenty to keep you busy as the nights draw in.

We've put together an early guide to what's coming to the service, including new movies like Ben Affleck's Animals and the F1 documentary Schumacher ’94 — The Birth of a Legend.
The official poster for HOLLYWOOD ARTS is here!

The stakes for Kate Wyler have never been higher. Netflix has officially unveiled the first trailer, poster, and a batch of new images for The Diplomat Season 4, and it looks like international war is closer than ever. Following the Emmy Awards, we finally have our first look at the conspiracy unfolding between Vice President Hal Wyler and President Grace Penn.

This season, Kate must form an uneasy alliance with Todd Penn (played by Bradley Whitford) to prevent her own husband and the President from upending the global balance of power. With eight new episodes confirmed, the series is set to return on October 15, 2026.

From a stolen Russian "apocalypse weapon" to marriages that "threaten to eat each other alive," the new footage promises plenty of the sharp political drama and interpersonal tension we’ve come to expect from showrunner Debora Cahn.
